hero.caption:
A photomicrograph of Clostridium botulinum bacteria.
This is an illustration of a photomicrograph of Clostridium botulinum stained with Gentian violet. The bacterium C. botulinum produces a nerve toxin, which causes the rare, but serious paralytic illness Botulism.
